models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Telegrams transcribed from the JACAR PDFs; doubtful letters re-read by Brice Dudout in blind panels.
Search of the condenser family (consonant rotation, vowel order) scored with a Chinese character model; key accepted only if it read telegrams it was not fitted to.
Chinese text punctuated and translated; doubtful codes marked.
Read share recounted with sure codes only (README rule of PR #728) from the status column of decryption.txt: 43 of 44 codes (0.977); 1 of 2 telegrams under 95%; class read -> read in part.
Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026: under 40 codes, at most 2 holes) applied to the 18 Nov counts: 0064 (18/19) read; class read in part -> read.

validation.notes: Chinese plaintext through the telegraph code: the letter n-gram test cannot run on Chinese characters; the readings were checked by sense

outcome.fraction_read_source: Sure codes only (18 Nov 2026): 43 of 44 codes marked ok (or confirmed) in decryption.txt; doubtful and illegible codes are holes; 1 of 2 telegrams under 95%. Before: probable (doubtful) codes counted as read. Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026): 0064 (18/19) under 40 codes with at most 2 holes, so read; every document is now read and the class stays read.
